title: Bourbon Street clubs and leaving for vaudeville shows in 1928
summary: He played Bourbon Street spots such as the Silver Slipper, then in 1928 joined presentation (vaudeville) shows.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Yeah, yeah. And, uh... Well, all in all, of course, after playing around here, all them years, I made Burden Street up and down the street. Played Silver Slipper in the old days. And, uh... Played for... Played for... Loey Primer played out on Burden Street there. It's right across from the... From the... Show Bar. You know that club right across the street? I forgot the name of it. No, he was given... Years ago. And then, I... I start to hit the road then. I hit the road in about 1928. I joined... Uh... What you call... Presentation shows. Something like this.
Yeah, this is strictly a vaudeville show.
I see they got the girls there.
